title: Content Asset Selection in Content Studio

notes: Makes the existing Brand-scoped Content Asset Library useful inside Content Studio by attaching selected indexed assets to an exact immutable Content Version.
Selections are server-authorized and snapshotted as non-secret provenance; client-supplied provider metadata is never trusted.
Changing production-asset selection creates a new Content Version so Truth Gate, Critic and human approval remain exact-version bound.
No Drive binary is downloaded, copied, transformed or published; no provider network call is required to select already-indexed metadata.
Content Asset references remain production inputs and do not mutate Brand Brain truth or Knowledge evidence.
VS-60 was owner-approved and merged at exact candidate 9d221453f19b1200be65071774173e83e4bedd0e as main merge b78b783e62b707cfecf6ddab211449ebd8494074; no deployment or provider activation followed.

approvals.rationale: After approving the exact VS-60 merge, owner instructed go next. VS-61 is the bounded continuation that consumes the already-approved Content Asset Library inside existing FR-10/FR-11 Content Studio scope.

This slice selects already-indexed Brand-scoped metadata only. It does not request new provider scopes, connect Google, download provider content, publish content, mutate Brand Brain, or change production settings.
Go authorizes bounded implementation, tests, UI review and exact-head certification gates. Merge, deployment and production enablement remain separate approvals.
Requires Product Intake, Security baseline, CI and implementation-level UI Review on one frozen exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
No deployment, provider activation or production enablement is authorized by this slice approval.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: A creator can deliberately attach up to 12 Brand-authorized indexed production assets to the current Content Version and preserve that exact selection through review/approval lineage.
metrics: approval surviving a changed asset selection
